title: Pakistan Animal Quarantine Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Animal Quarantine Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1985
ACT V OF 1985
PAKISTAN ANIMAL, QUARANTINE (IMPORT AND EXPORT OF ANIMALS AND ANIMAL
PRODUCTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Animal Quarantine
(Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products)
Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :
1. Short title and commencement.-----(1) This Act may be called the
Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products)
(Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Animal Quarantine Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 10, Ordinance XLIX of 1979

ACT V OF 1985
ACT V OF 1985
PAKISTAN ANIMAL, QUARANTINE (IMPORT AND EXPORT OF ANIMALS AND ANIMAL
PRODUCTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Animal Quarantine
(Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products)
Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :
2. Amendment of section 10, Ordinance XLIX of 1979.----In the Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and
Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979 (XLIX of 1979), in
section 10, in subsection (1), for the full stop at the end a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely:
"Provided that no order on such revision shall be passed unless the
applicant has been given an opportunity of being heard.".
